description: This file defines a client class for interacting with the Amazon Managed Blockchain Query service in AWS SDK for PHP. It includes method annotations for available operations and inherits from a general AWS client.

classes.name: ManagedBlockchainQueryClient
classes.description: A specialized AWS client class used to interact with Amazon Managed Blockchain Query service.

methods.name: batchGetTokenBalance
methods.description: Retrieves token balances for specified assets.

methods.name: batchGetTokenBalanceAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves token balances for specified assets.

methods.name: getAssetContract
methods.description: Fetches details about an asset contract.

methods.name: getAssetContractAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches details about an asset contract.

methods.name: getTokenBalance
methods.description: Gets the token balance for a given account.

methods.name: getTokenBalanceAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously gets the token balance for a given account.

methods.name: getTransaction
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific blockchain transaction.

methods.name: getTransactionAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves details of a specific blockchain transaction.
